map.输入浓度、温度与污染度等级，评估水基切削液/冷却液使用寿命: Enter concentration, temperature and contamination grade to assess the service life of water-based cutting / cooling fluid
map.水基液寿命评估：依据浓度、温度与 ISO 4406 污染度等级，综合微生物繁殖与: Water-based fluid life assessment: based on concentration, temperature and ISO 4406 contamination grade, comprehensively evaluate water-based cutting / cooling fluid service life from microbial growth and contamination degree, for tank change interval determination.
map.💡 L = L0 × f_conc × f_temp × f_contam；基础: L = L0 times f_conc times f_temp times f_contam; base life 180 days, deviating from 5-8% concentration range accelerates degradation
map.水基液推荐浓度 5-8%，过低易生菌，过高刺激皮肤: Recommended water-based fluid concentration 5-8%; too low easily breeds bacteria, too high irritates skin
map.温度超过 40℃ 后微生物繁殖加速，寿命大幅缩短: Above 40 C microbial growth accelerates and life drops sharply
map.ISO 污染度每增加 3 级，寿命约减半: Each 3 ISO contamination grades increase halves the life
map.📚 深度解析：水基液寿命计算（浓度/温度/污染度三因子）: In-depth: Water-Based Fluid Life Calculation (concentration / temperature / contamination three factors)
map.切削液维护：按浓度与温度估算换液周期: Cutting fluid maintenance: estimate fluid change interval by concentration and temperature
map.微生物风险预判：高温低浓度时提前加杀菌剂: Microbial risk prediction: add biocide in advance at high temperature and low concentration
map.过滤改进评估：改善过滤降低 ISO 等级后的寿命提升: Filtration improvement evaluation: life improvement after improving filtration to lower ISO grade
map.算法：基准寿命 180 天；浓度因子 5%~8% 取 1.0、3%~5% 取 0: Algorithm: base life 180 days; concentration factor at 5% to 8% takes 1.0, at 3% to 5% takes 0.7 + (concentration minus 3) / 2 times 0.3, at 8% to 12% takes 0.9 minus (concentration minus 8) / 4 times 0.2, otherwise takes 0.4; temperature factor at or below 30 C takes 1 + (30 minus temperature) / 60, above 30 C takes 0.5 to the power of ((temperature minus 30) / 10); contamination factor = 0.5 to the power of ((ISO grade minus 17) / 3); life = 180 times concentration factor times temperature factor times contamination factor (days); microbial risk: above 40 C and concentration below 5% is high risk, above 35 C or concentration below 5% is medium risk, otherwise low risk; above 40 C pH drops rapidly.
map.例：浓度 5%、温度 35℃、ISO 17 → 浓度因子 1、温度因子 0.70: Example: concentration 5%, temperature 35 C, ISO 17 gives concentration factor 1, temperature factor 0.7071, contamination factor 1, life 127 days (4.2 months), microbial low risk, pH slowly drops, suggest normal life, periodic testing and maintenance. If concentration drops to 4%, temperature rises to 45 C, contamination to ISO 20, the three factors become 0.85, 0.3536, 0.5 respectively, life drops sharply to 27 days (0.9 months), microbial high risk, pH drops rapidly, biocide must be added, concentration raised and filtration improved.
map.浓度为什么不是越高越好？: Why is higher concentration not always better?
map.最适区间 5%~8%。浓度过低润滑与防锈不足、易滋生细菌；过高则泡沫多、皮肤刺激: The optimum range is 5% to 8%. Too low concentration gives insufficient lubrication and rust prevention and easily breeds bacteria; too high gives more foam, skin irritation and higher cost, and in the tool above 8% the concentration factor drops below 0.9.
map.ISO 污染度等级怎么取得？: How to obtain the ISO contamination grade?
map.按 ISO 4406 用颗粒计数仪测定（如 17/15/12），工具取第一级数值: By ISO 4406 with a particle counter (e.g. 17/15/12), the tool takes the first-stage value; without an instrument, conservatively estimate by filtration precision and change frequency, improving filtration usually lowers 2 to 3 grades.
